actions.action: Stage resumable uploads; stream verified files.
actions.mechanism: Durable disk or object storage separates connection recovery from processing without buffering the 4 GB file.
actions.implementation: Persist upload offsets; verify the supplied digest before processing. Stream CSV with bounded queues, capped record buffers, and disk spill.
actions.check: Disconnect halfway, resume, and verify the digest. Test oversized and multiline records; peak process memory must remain below 128 MB.
actions.risk: Staging needs storage quotas, cleanup, and a defined digest algorithm.

actions.action: Commit row outcomes and progress with writes.
actions.mechanism: A transactional receipt makes retries idempotent even when commit succeeds but its acknowledgment is lost.
actions.implementation: Identify imports by tenant and verified digest. Atomically commit bounded batches of writes, unique source-line receipts, and checkpoints; explicitly reject conflicting natural keys.
actions.check: Crash before and after commit and acknowledgment. Replay must produce identical accepted keys and outcomes without duplicate writes.
actions.risk: Concurrent imports require database-enforced natural-key uniqueness and an explicit conflict policy.

actions.action: Quarantine invalid rows with actionable diagnostics.
actions.mechanism: Row-level isolation prevents invalid references from aborting unrelated rows or being replaced with plausible defaults.
actions.implementation: Validate without coercion. Use savepoints or rollback-and-bisect batches for row errors. Export line, natural key, field, offending value, and reason.
actions.check: Inject missing references and concurrent reference deletion. Valid neighbors must commit; each rejected row must retain its original input and location.
actions.risk: System failures must remain retryable, not be misclassified as rejected rows.

actions.mechanism: Durable outcome accounting distinguishes completed partial imports from interrupted imports and exposes missing or repeated work.
actions.implementation: Record EOF and terminal outcomes. Reconcile parsed records against disjoint accepted/rejected receipts and transactional write evidence; link corrected submissions to original rejections.
actions.check: Report partial whenever rejections or unfinished input remain. At completion, every parsed record must have exactly one outcome; corrections must resolve linked rejections.
actions.risk: Malformed CSV boundaries can prevent complete accounting; report the blocked location rather than guessing.
